label: Chigee
note: In Inner Mongolia the starter is a palm-sized cloth bag (hurunge) carrying the microbes of last year's chigee.

about.text: A traditional fermented mare's milk of Mongolia and Inner Mongolia, soured and lightly alcoholic by spontaneous fermentation with lactic bacteria and yeasts, closely related to airag.

links.name: Food Sci. Nutr. (2020), 188 Xilin Gol samples; Table 2

how.text: The lactic acid bacteria mostly acidify; the yeasts add some acetic acid and the alcohol. Lactobacillus species for chigee itself were not found in the abstracts opened, and fermentation time and temperature were not found.
